I use code as part of the research workflow: constructing large environmental datasets, computing heat-stress metrics, running spatial and statistical analyses, and experimenting with network and agent-based models.

Public research repositories will be linked here as they are cleaned, documented, and made reusable.

Current GitHub profile: [github.com/anonycoderama](https://github.com/anonycoderama)

Where possible, each research page will link directly to its corresponding repository so that code remains attached to the scientific question, assumptions, and results it supports.
